expected_types.GRWTSK.FourierAnalysis.FourierAnalysisIn:
∀ {ι : Type u} [Countable ι] (f : ι → Real → Complex)
  (hc : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
  (hp : ∀ i, Function.Periodic (f i) (2 * Real.pi)),
  Filter.Eventually (fun x : Real =>
    ∀ (s : Finset ι) (W : Nat → ι → Complex) (w : ι → Complex),
      (∀ i ∈ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun N : Nat => W N i) Filter.atTop (nhds (w i))) →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun N : Nat => Finset.sum s (fun i => W N i * _root_.partialFourierSum N (f i) x))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (Finset.sum s (fun i => w i * f i x))))
    (MeasureTheory.ae (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure Real))

∀ {ι : Type u} [Countable ι] (f : ι → Real → Complex)
  (hc : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
  (hp : ∀ i, Function.Periodic (f i) (2 * Real.pi)),
  Filter.Eventually (fun x : Real =>
    ∀ (s : Finset ι) (W : Nat → ι → Complex) (w : ι → Complex),
      (∀ i ∈ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun N : Nat => W N i) Filter.atTop (nhds (w i))) →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun N : Nat => Norm.norm
          ((Finset.sum s (fun i => W N i * _root_.partialFourierSum N (f i) x)) -
            (Finset.sum s (fun i => w i * f i x))))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : Real)))
    (MeasureTheory.ae (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure Real))

hypotheses.fixed_data: iota:Type u with Countable iota; one fixed family f:iota→Real→Complex with every f_i continuous and Function.Periodic(f_i)(2*Real.pi), all before the Lebesgue-a.e. event.
hypotheses.inside_one_event: For every finite s:Finset iota, every W:Nat→iota→Complex and w:iota→Complex, assume ∀i∈s, Tendsto(fun N=>W N i) atTop (nhds(w i)). These choices occur AFTER x in the a.e. predicate; no uncountable intersection of separate a.e. events is used.
hypotheses.support_and_domain: s is fixed as N:Nat tends atTop. Empty support and a countably infinite ambient index type are allowed. Coefficient convergence is required only on s.
hypotheses.coefficient_bound: No l1-unit-ball or uniform row bound is assumed. Actual coefficientwise convergence is an explicit premise; the theorem constructs no convergent coefficient family.

conclusion.readout: On that one event, sum_{i∈s} W(N,i)*partialFourierSum N(f_i)(x) tends in Complex to the FIXED limiting-weight readout sum_{i∈s}w(i)*f_i(x).
conclusion.fixed_residual: The norm of the difference between that actual moving-coefficient Fourier readout and the SAME fixed limiting-weight reference tends to zero in Real.
conclusion.quantifier_boundary: The event depends only on the fixed countable function family. Cutoffs/moduli may depend on x,s,W,w and their convergence; no cutoff uniform over all convergent rows/supports/x is supplied.

proof_route: Use the actual old countable-family coordinate-convergence event once; inside it multiply coefficient limits by coordinate Fourier limits and apply finite-sum continuity. Subtract the fixed limiting reference and apply norm continuity for the second root.

upstream.selected_endpoint: ∀ {f : ℝ → ℂ}, Continuous f → f.Periodic (2 * Real.pi) → ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => partialFourierSum N f x) Filter.atTop (nhds (f x))
